about_the_game:
After a steamy night at Bonekeep Castle, your futanari cards have vanished!
Scattered across gothic libraries, locked rooms, and even damp graveyards, you'll have to rummage through every corner of this naughty castle to recover them. Each room is a provocative trap, full of interactive objects and clever hiding spots.

This is an adult hidden object game, made for those who love to poke around where they shouldn’t. Take your time, uncover the surprises, and recover all 100 naughty cards before sunrise… or lose yourself in Bonekeep’s forbidden pleasures.

  • Adult hidden object game with spicy, uncensored interactions

  • Explore 7 unique rooms, complete with visual secrets and a hidden chamber

  • Find 100 Futanari cards and unlock your personal gallery

  • Designed to play one-handed, at your own pace

  • Sensual design with provocative art and gothic-erotic atmosphere

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains explicit nudity, consensual sexual content, and mature themes. It focuses on Futanari characters presented in many forms, such as monsters, angels, demons, cyborgs, and others. 

Sexual interactions occur between humans and non-human creatures, including monsters. Some characters appear in BDSM outfits and fetish gear. For mature audiences only.
